# Phạm Văn Ngoan (Pham Van Ngoan · Ngoan Phạm · Ngoan Pham · NgoanPV)

> AI builder based in Viet Nam. Builds AI systems that listen, reason and hold up in production: multi-agent systems, voice AI, retrieval (RAG / GraphRAG) and the evaluation that keeps them honest.

- Also known as: Pham Van Ngoan, Ngoan Phạm, Ngoan Pham, NgoanPV, ngoanpv
- Website: https://ngoanpv.github.io/
- GitHub: https://github.com/ngoanpv
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ngoanpv
- App Store (side projects): https://apps.apple.com/vn/developer/ngoan-pham-van/id1711897094

## Currently exploring
- Simulated crowds of personas grounded in real answers
- How reactions spread through networks of agents
- Evals that can abstain when the evidence isn't there
- Benchmarking the reliability and calibration of LLM agents
- Memory for AI agents and robots: what to keep, forget and recall
- On-device models: small, quantized, distilled, running offline

## Open source
- DeepInterview — voice-first multi-agent mock interviewer: https://github.com/ngoanpv/DeepInterview
- llama2_vietnamese: https://github.com/ngoanpv/llama2_vietnamese
- albert_vi: https://github.com/ngoanpv/albert_vi
